name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 20 – Am 107
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 20a. Stresses that civil society organisations must be free to pursue their objectives and undertake research, education and advocacy on issues of public debate, including where their positions challenge government policies or call for changes to the law, in accordance with the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union and relevant international and European standards, including the Council of Europe Recommendation CM/Rec(2007)14;
